KPIL has incurred capex of ~INR 3,000 Crore in last 5 years (FY 2021-22 - FY 2025-26), including capex of INR 917 Crore during the year FY25-26.
In FY 2025-26, T&D revenue has increased by 25% from INR 10,026 Crore in FY 2024-25 to INR 12,501 Crore in FY 2025-26.
Growth & demand: With a robust order book of INR 65,457 Crores as of 31st March, 2026, we remain well positioned to deliver sustained and profitable growth.
